scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Hey, adventurer.
I can take you to somewhere nice. Are you interested?
scripts.translation:
[騙子]
嘿，冒險者。
我可以帶你去個好地方，你有興趣嗎？

scripts.text: Move to Eden Market Group!
scripts.translation: 前往樂園團市場！

scripts.text: About Eden Market Group.
scripts.translation: 關於樂園團市場

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Moving~!
scripts.translation:
[騙子]
出發咯~！

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Hahaha... The Eden Market Group is a place where merchants gather around to sell various items.
And I don't mean common stuff like Jellopy, which you can acquire anywhere. Here, we only deal in real goods.
scripts.translation:
[騙子]
哈哈哈...樂園團市場是商人聚集、出售各種商品的地方。
賣的可不是隨處可見的傑勒比結晶之類的普通貨色，這裡只有真傢伙。

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Simple ingredients, precious stones, rare items from dungeons and excavation sites, and exotic artifacts that hail from another dimension...
Everything you could ever want!
scripts.translation:
[騙子]
普通材料、名貴寶石、地下城和遺蹟裡出土的珍稀物品，還有異次元來的奇珍異寶...
你想要的，這裡都有！

scripts.text: You mean, this is a black market?!
scripts.translation: 你是說，這是黑市？！

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Ah... I wouldn't say that.
This marketplace is, say, technically legal...
Keep in mind that most special products are of ^4d4dfflimited quantity^000000. If you are late, they might be sold out.
scripts.translation:
[騙子]
啊...可別這麼說。
真要論起來，這市場可是合法的...
不過，多數特別商品都^4d4dff限量供應^000000，來晚了，可就賣光了。

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Don't expect discounts for most limited quantity items.
You have to pay the full price.
scripts.translation:
[騙子]
大多數限量商品不提供折扣。
你必須支付全價。

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Adventurers sometimes come by to sell what they have found on their expeditions.
But you have to see for yourself!
scripts.translation:
[騙子]
冒險者有時會來出售他們在探險中發現的物品。
但你自己得親眼看看！

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Keep in mind that most stores are closed one day out of the week; ^4d4dffmost stores are not open on Wednesdays^000000.
Though, not all of them close on Wednesdays; majority of them are still open.
scripts.translation:
[騙子]
請記住，大多數商店每週有一天休息；^4d4dff大多數商店在週三不營業^000000。
不過，並非所有商店都在週三休息；大多數商店仍然營業。

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
More special items are sold on weekends.
I have even seen an {0} being sold~
It was amazing.
Of course it was super expensive and only a handful were up for sale.
scripts.translation:
[騙子]
週末還有更多稀奇貨。
我連{0}都見過呢~真不得了。
當然，價格貴得嚇人，總共也沒幾件。

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
How about it? Interested?
Isn't it worth paying a visit?
Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[騙子]
怎麼樣？有興趣嗎？
難道不值得去參觀一下嗎？
哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Hustler]
Come by anytime, if you want to go to the Eden Market Group!
scripts.translation:
[騙子]
如果你想前往樂園團市場，隨時歡迎！

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Hello. Welcome to Eden Market Group, the official marketplace run by the continental merchant coalition, supported by the Eden Group.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
你好。歡迎來到樂園團市場，這是由大陸商人聯盟運營、樂園團支援的官方市場。

scripts.text: About when we're open.
scripts.translation: 關於營業時間

scripts.text: About Special Products.
scripts.translation: 關於特殊商品

scripts.text: About Eden Market Group.
scripts.translation: 關於樂園團市場

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Eden Market Group is a marketplace that contains many different shops.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
樂園團市場裡有各式各樣的商店。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Wednesday is an official holiday designated by the marketplace; most shops are closed on this day.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
週三是市場指定的官方假日；大多數商店在這一天關閉。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
However, depending on the owner's wishes, and the type of items being offered, some shops remain partially open even on the holiday.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
不過，是否休息也取決於店主和商品種類，有些店在休息日仍會營業。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
And, some shops offer special items on certain days of the week. Keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
另外，有些商店會在每週的特定日子出售特殊物品。請留意這一點。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Some shops will sell different items on weekends, certain days of the week, or even during certain hours; these items are different than their usual daily items.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
有些商店會在週末、每週的特定日子，甚至特定時間段出售不同的物品；這些物品與它們平時的日常商品不同。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
'Wonderful Friends' and 'Strong Friends' will sell one rare item each weekend.
'Miner's Coalition' will sell the anvil for blacksmithing only on weekends.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
“奇妙好友”和“強力好友”每個週末會各出售一種稀有商品。
“礦工聯盟”的鍛造用鐵砧，則只在週末出售。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
I cannot tell you what items individual shops sell, because they are all different.
Why don't you find out for yourself by visiting often?
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
我無法告訴你各個商店具體賣什麼，因為每家都不同。
何不經常來逛逛，親自去發現呢？

scripts.text:
[Guide]
There are many people with the soul of a merchant that would like to sell their items to people in need of such.
Eden Market Group has designated a place for such people to buy and sell.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
不少人都有經商的熱情，想把手裡的東西賣給有需要的人。
樂園團市場就為他們提供了買賣的場所。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
We provide the means for goods that would otherwise have been contraband to be bought and sold in a fair and transparent manner, working in conjunction with the merchant coalitions and adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
我們與商人聯盟和冒險者合作，提供一種公平且透明的方式，讓原本可能屬於違禁品的貨物得以買賣。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Some people mutter that Eden Market Group is a black market... Haha, what a silly idea...
We are merely a merchant coalition.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
有些人竊竊私語說樂園團市場是黑市...哈哈，真是可笑的想法...
我們只是一個商人聯盟。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
A portion of our profits go towards running the Eden Group, an adventurer's guild.
You can sell the loot from your adventures here, and the profits we make go towards providing services that benefit you. We are killing two birds with one stone, really.
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
市場的一部分利潤，會用於運營冒險者公會樂園團。
您在這裡出售冒險戰利品，我們再將收益用於為冒險者提供服務，確實一舉兩得。

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Keep in mind that limited quantity items will never go on sale!
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
請記住，限量物品絕不會打折出售！

scripts.text:
[Guide]
Have a good time!
scripts.translation:
[嚮導]
祝你玩得開心！

scripts.text:
[Cassie]
Do you wish to buy a drink?
scripts.translation:
[凱西]
你想買杯飲料嗎？

scripts.text: Tropical Sograt.
scripts.translation: 熱帶的蘇克拉特

scripts.text: Vermilion on the Beach.
scripts.translation: 赤色海灘

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Cassie]
Have a good time.
scripts.translation:
[凱西]
祝你玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Cassie]
A drink costs 800z.
scripts.translation:
[凱西]
一杯飲料800 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Cassie]
Enjoy it
scripts.translation:
[凱西]
請享用。

scripts.text:
[Leria]
I sell coins that I have collected from alternate dimensions.
Purchase whatever catches your eye.
Be warned: they are rather pricey. I had to go through immense trouble in order to procure them.
scripts.translation:
[萊莉婭]
我出售從異次元收集的硬幣，喜歡什麼就挑吧。
先說好，價格不便宜，弄到它們可費了我不少工夫。

scripts.text: See what is up for sale.
scripts.translation: 看看有什麼在賣

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Leria]
I may not have any stock left since I sell only a handful of items.
scripts.translation:
[萊莉婭]
由於我只出售少量物品，可能已經售罄了。

scripts.text:
[Leria]
Since I scour the world to find the items that I sell, the price is high...
But there are those who buy them anyway.
scripts.translation:
[萊莉婭]
因為我走遍世界尋找這些物品，所以價格很高...
但依然有人購買。

scripts.text:
[Leria]
Well, those who need them must pay the price. Isn't that so?
scripts.translation:
[萊莉婭]
需要它們的人，就得付出相應的代價。不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Leria]
Ah... Today is the marketplace holiday.
Come back tomorrow if you need coins.
scripts.translation:
[萊莉婭]
啊...今天是集市休息日。
如果您需要硬幣，請明天再來。

scripts.text:
[Heimhunter]
Ah, are you the customer that wants 'that' from the ancient castle?
I can only get one per day, but I will sell it.
scripts.translation:
[海姆獵手]
啊，您就是想買古城裡“那個”的客人？
我一天只能弄到一個，可以賣給您。

scripts.text: See the item.
scripts.translation: 檢視物品

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Heimhunter]
There's only one..
It might have been bought by someone else already.
Please understand.
scripts.translation:
[海姆獵手]
只有一個...
可能已經被別人買走了。
請諒解。

scripts.text:
[Heimhunter]
As you wish.
scripts.translation:
[海姆獵手]
如您所願。

scripts.text:
[Heimhunter]
Today is the official market holiday.
I will take a break, too.
scripts.translation:
[海姆獵手]
今天是正式的集市休息日。
我也要休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Zephet]
Do you need keys?
I may have some extra keys for the clock tower?..
scripts.translation:
[澤菲特]
需要鑰匙嗎？
我這裡也許還有多餘的鐘樓鑰匙...

scripts.text: Buy keys.
scripts.translation: 購買鑰匙

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Zephet]
I gather and sell the keys for the clock tower all by myself...
Even though I scavenge for them all week, there's not a lot available.
They may be sold out already.
scripts.translation:
[澤菲特]
我獨自收集並出售鐘樓的鑰匙...
雖然我整週都在搜尋，但數量並不多。
可能已經賣光了。

scripts.text:
[Zephet]
You have no need of keys?
Remember that I sell keys here only on weekends.
Just for your information.
scripts.translation:
[澤菲特]
您不需要鑰匙嗎？
請記住，我只在週末出售鑰匙。
僅供參考。

scripts.text:
[Zephet]
I don't have enough keys yet.
Come back after Saturday afternoon.
scripts.translation:
[澤菲特]
我目前的鑰匙還不夠。
請在週六下午之後再來。

scripts.text:
== Strong Friends == 
From common weapons to priceless jewel-encrusted swords!
Every weapon that you could ever want is here for your perusal.
scripts.translation:
== 強力好友 ==
從普通武器到鑲嵌珍貴寶石的寶劍！
您想要的所有武器都在這裡供您挑選。

scripts.text:
[Miffy]
A limited collection, only available on fiery Friday, Saturday and Sunday!
We offer an assortment of ancient weapons that adventurers have retrieved from dungeons!
scripts.translation:
[米菲]
限量珍藏，只在熱鬧的週五、週六、週日出售！
各式古代武器，都是冒險者從地下城里帶回來的！

scripts.text: Look at the items.
scripts.translation: 檢視物品

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Miffy]
Let us show you the 'Strong Friends' special collection.
If you open the chest and there's nothing there, 
That means the weapon has already been sold.
The spoils go toward people with quick reflexes.
scripts.translation:
[米菲]
來看看“強力好友”的特別珍藏吧。
箱子空了，就說明武器已經賣掉了，好東西要靠手快！

scripts.text:
[Miffy]
Special weapons sold on weekends!
Come see us anytime!
scripts.translation:
[米菲]
週末出售特別武器！
隨時歡迎來光顧！

scripts.text:
[Miffy]
Hello. This is the weapon shop 'Strong Friends'.
We sell weapons that adventurers retrieve from dungeons and in battle, 
roving over the continent.
scripts.translation:
[米菲]
歡迎光臨武器店“強力好友”。
這裡賣的武器，都是遊歷大陸的冒險者從地下城和戰場上帶回來的。

scripts.text:
[Miffy]
^000000Friday-Saturday-Sunday, a limited weapon collection offered for 3 consecutive days!^000000
Come see us anytime!
scripts.translation:
[米菲]
^000000週五-週六-週日，連續3天供應限量武器收藏！^000000
隨時歡迎來光顧！

scripts.text:
[Nelsha]
Hello.
This is 'Strong Friends', where a range of basic weapons are available for your perusal.
scripts.translation:
[內爾莎]
您好。
這裡是“強力好友”，您可以在此挑選各種基礎武器。

scripts.text: Maces, Rods, Knuckles
scripts.translation: 鈍器、法杖、拳套

scripts.text: One-Handed Swords, Two-Handed Sword
scripts.translation: 單手劍、雙手劍

scripts.text: Bows, Innstruments, Whips
scripts.translation: 弓、樂器、鞭子

scripts.text: Daggers, Katars
scripts.translation: 短劍、拳刃

scripts.text: Axes, Spears
scripts.translation: 斧頭、長矛

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nelsha]
Thank you for shopping.
scripts.translation:
[內爾莎]
感謝您的惠顧。

scripts.text:
[Nelsha]
I will show you {0}
scripts.translation:
[內爾莎]
這就為您展示{0}。

scripts.text:
== Reliable Friends == 
Do you need shields, armor, and sturdy helmets?
You can rely on Reliable Friends!
scripts.translation:
== 可靠好友 == 
您需要盾牌、盔甲和堅固的頭盔嗎？
您可以信賴“可靠好友”！

scripts.text:
[Coco]
Do you need sturdy armors to protect your frail body?
Or shields, to block the blows of your enemies?
scripts.translation:
[可可]
您需要堅固的盔甲來保護您嬌弱的身軀嗎？
或者盾牌，用來抵擋敵人的攻擊？

scripts.text: Look at armors.
scripts.translation: 看看盔甲

scripts.text: Look at shields.
scripts.translation: 看看盾牌

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Coco]
Cheap and sturdy armor.
scripts.translation:
[可可]
便宜又結實的盔甲。

scripts.text:
[Coco]
May, or may not, block blows made with reasonable force...
scripts.translation:
[可可]
一般力道的攻擊嘛...也許擋得住，也許擋不住...

scripts.text:
[Coco]
Come again.
scripts.translation:
[可可]
歡迎下次光臨。

scripts.text:
== Handsome Friends == 
A clothier for someone who loves to dress up!
scripts.translation:
== 帥氣好友 == 
專為熱愛裝扮的人準備的服裝店！

scripts.text:
[Minho Doh]
Limited item collection, only available on weekends!
Only one item. If you want it, purchase quickly! You know the drill.
scripts.translation:
[都敏浩]
週末限定珍藏！只有一件！
看中了就趕緊買，規矩您懂的。

scripts.text: See the collection.
scripts.translation: 看看收藏

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Minho Doh]
Here is our special collection!
If all the chests are empty, that means you are too late!
scripts.translation:
[都敏浩]
這是我們的特別收藏！
如果所有的箱子都是空的，那就意味著您來晚了！

scripts.text:
[Minho Doh]
See you again!
Hahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[都敏浩]
下次再見！
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Minho Doh]
Do you want to peruse our special collection of items?
But the collection wouldn't be special if you can see them every day, right?
scripts.translation:
[都敏浩]
您想看看我們的特別物品收藏嗎？
但如果每天都能看到，那就不特別了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Minho Doh]
Come on weekends if you want to see our special collection.
We sell ONE item per day, on ^000000 Saturdays and Sundays^000000.
scripts.translation:
[都敏浩]
想看我們的特別收藏，請在週末過來。
我們每天只賣一件商品，^000000只在週六和週日^000000。

scripts.text:
[Minho Doh]
Hahahaha.. Aren't you looking forward to the special items soon to be revealed? Muhahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[都敏浩]
哈哈哈...很期待即將登場的特別商品吧？
哇哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Lapelt]
Welcome! This is 'Handsome Friends', a clothier that will make you fashionable!
We sell common clothing and hats even on holidays.
scripts.translation:
[拉佩爾特]
歡迎光臨！這裡是“帥氣好友”，一家讓你變得時尚的服裝店！
即使是節假日，我們也出售普通的衣服和帽子。

scripts.text: Clothes and shoes.
scripts.translation: 衣服和長靴

scripts.text: Hats and glasses.
scripts.translation: 帽子和眼鏡

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Lapelt]
Don't look down on the items just because they are cheap.
They are well-made items from all over the world.
scripts.translation:
[拉佩爾特]
不要因為價格便宜就看不起這些商品。
它們都是來自世界各地的優質商品。

scripts.text:
[Lapelt]
Fashion comes from matching accessories!
With matching items and a good hat, you can stand on the apex of fashion!
scripts.translation:
[拉佩爾特]
時尚講究搭配！
配飾搭得好，再戴上一頂好帽子，你就是時尚的頂點！

scripts.text:
[Lapelt]
Goodbye.
scripts.translation:
[拉佩爾特]
再見。

scripts.text:
== Meds for Pharmacists == 
We sell assorted potions.

[Days of Operation]
Special potions - Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri, Sat
Common potions - every day
scripts.translation:
== 藥劑師藥品 == 
我們出售各種藥水。

[營業日]
特殊藥水 - 週一、週二、週四、週五、週六
普通藥水 - 每天

scripts.text:
[Head Pharmacist]
Potent poisons that will knock you out with one sip, meds that will protect your body and spirit, meds that will temporarily grant supernatural speed.
We have them all.
'Meds for Pharmacists', here to supply you with the medication you need.
scripts.translation:
[首席藥劑師]
一口就能讓你昏厥的強力毒藥，保護身體和精神的藥品，暫時賦予超自然速度的藥品。
我們應有盡有。
“藥劑師藥品”，為您提供所需的藥品。

scripts.text: Meds, please!
scripts.translation: 我要買藥！

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Head Pharmacist]
This is what we currently have left.
If there's nothing, it means that we are sold out.
We do not brew potions in large batches. Please understand.
scripts.translation:
[首席藥劑師]
這是目前剩下的庫存，列表空了就代表賣完了。
我們不大量調配藥水，還請諒解。

scripts.text:
[Head Pharmacist]
Come back if you have questions about the meds.
scripts.translation:
[首席藥劑師]
如果您對藥品有疑問，請回來詢問。

scripts.text:
[Head Pharmacist]
Oh, you need potions?
We do not sell common meds. We stick to special potions.
And today is a holiday. We are currently brewing new potions.
scripts.translation:
[首席藥劑師]
哦，需要藥水？
我這裡專賣特殊藥水，不賣普通藥品。
不過今天休息，正忙著調配新藥水呢。

scripts.text:
[Head Pharmacist]
I will show you a collection of our superior potions if you come back tomorrow, okay?
Hehe~
scripts.translation:
[首席藥劑師]

Good potions sold at an affordable price.

這裡有治療藥水。
以實惠的價格出售優質藥水。

I will take them off your hands and pay you a hefty price.
Don't tell other people I paid so much.
scripts.translation:

東西交給我，我會給您個好價錢。
可別告訴別人，我出價這麼高。

[Johanna]
Most shops in the Eden Market Group do not operate on holidays.
Some shops remain open on holidays, however.
scripts.translation:
[約翰娜]
樂園團市場的大多數商店在節假日不營業。
不過，有些商店在節假日也會開門。

scripts.text:
[Johanna]
Our pharmacy offers common healing potions even on holidays, though not the special potions.
Take advantage of our services!
scripts.translation:
[約翰娜]
休息日雖然不賣特殊藥水，但普通恢復藥水照常供應，歡迎選購！

scripts.text:
[Johanna]
Goodbye.
scripts.translation:

再見。

scripts.text:
[Wyn]
..Hello...
This is 'For Meds Pharmacists'....
Do you need Blue Potions...?
I make 100 of them each day... yes... just me.
scripts.translation:
[溫]
...你好...
這裡是“藥劑師藥品”...
你需要藍色藥水嗎...？
我每天製作100瓶...是的...只有我一個人。

[Wyn]
Uhhh.. Not sure we have any left.
A moment please. If not, we are sold out..
Aaaaa... Do I have to make more.
Aaa... The stench of herbs
Feel like throwing up... Aaa..
scripts.translation:
[溫]
呃...不知道還剩多少，稍等。
沒東西就說明賣完了...
啊啊...又得再做一批嗎？
啊...聞著這股草藥味就想吐...啊...

scripts.text:
[Wyn]
Thank you.. Come again.
scripts.translation:
[溫]
謝謝...歡迎再來。

scripts.text:
[Wyn]
Uhhh... Headache..
I started working to pay off my college tuition...
I feel like throwing up. Surrounded by the smell of herbs all week.
Blerch-!
scripts.translation:
[溫]
呃...頭疼...
本來只是為了掙學費才來打工的...
一整週都泡在草藥味裡，真想吐。
嘔——！

Is there anything you want?

Here are the traps.
'We-Have-Everything' is always here for you.

這些是陷阱。

Thank you for being a loyal customer of 'We-Have-Everything'.

感謝您成為“我們應有盡有”的忠實顧客。
歡迎再來。

Hello, this is 'We-Have-Everything'.
Wednesdays are Eden Market Group official holidays, so we are not open during this time.
Goodbye.

你好，這裡是“我們應有盡有”。

scripts.text:
[Jeffrey]
Everyone assumes that I am the cook here. I'm not! I'm just here to collect on the debt that the restaurant owner owes me!
scripts.translation:
[傑弗裡]
大家都以為我是這裡的廚師。我不是！我只是來討回餐館老闆欠我的債！

scripts.text:
[Jeffrey]
I made a few dishes just to shut up the complaining customers, but this is getting out of hand!
scripts.translation:
[傑弗裡]
我只是為了讓那些抱怨的顧客閉嘴才做了幾道菜，但這簡直失控了！

scripts.text:
[Vincent]
... The new cook makes amazing food, but apparently he's pretty lazy.
scripts.translation:
[文森特]
...新廚師做的菜很美味，但聽說他挺懶的。

scripts.text:
[Panel]
This restaurant opened only recently, but it became really popular after they hired a new cook.
scripts.translation:
[面板]
這家餐館剛開張不久，但在聘請了新廚師後變得非常受歡迎。

scripts.text:
[Matina]
What is it? Are you going to order? Forget it. Look at the line-up.
scripts.translation:
[瑪蒂娜]
怎麼，想點餐？算了吧，看看排隊的人有多少。

scripts.text:
[Lucy]
Ah. I am going to wait a little more, but if I am still not served, I will leave.
scripts.translation:
[露西]
啊。我再等一會兒，但如果還是沒人理我，我就走了。

scripts.text:
[Mara]
I heard that the owner of this restaurant went on a trip to a faraway land, and the new cook is running this place. I heard that his cooking skill is amazing.
scripts.translation:
[瑪拉]
我聽說這家餐館的老闆去遠方旅行了，現在是由新廚師在經營。聽說他的廚藝非常驚人。

scripts.text:
[Lana]
I came two days ago, yesterday, and today too. The pasta they serve here is amazing. The only problem is that it's so hard to order here.
scripts.translation:
[拉娜]
我前天、昨天和今天都來了。這裡的意麵非常美味。唯一的問題是，在這裡點餐太難了。

scripts.text:
[Rahoul]
I have been waiting for hours already and the cook is still not taking orders. Ah, I am so hungry that I might drop dead.
scripts.translation:
[拉烏爾]
等了好幾個小時，廚師還不接單。
啊，快餓死了。

scripts.text:
[Drunk]
Hey, bring more wine...
scripts.translation:
[醉漢]
嘿，再拿點酒來...

scripts.text:
[Annoyed Customer]
I am going to talk to the owner once he comes back from his trip. Tell him to fire his employees there at the back.
So many customers milling about, and they aren't even serving anyone
scripts.translation:
[不耐煩的顧客]
等老闆旅行回來，我一定要找他談談。讓他把後面那些員工都開除。
這麼多顧客在排隊，居然沒人接待。

scripts.text:
[Kalin]
I am Thrann's colleague and I like being a cleaner at this store. I can be as lazy as I want and still get paid.
scripts.translation:
[卡琳]
我是斯蘭的同事，我喜歡在這家店當清潔工。我可以想偷懶就偷懶，照樣能拿到工資。

scripts.text:
[Thrann]
I spend hours here drinking coffee in peace, though I am technically at work, pretending to clean. They don't even kick me out.
scripts.translation:
[斯蘭]
我花好幾個小時在這裡安靜地喝咖啡。雖然名義上是在工作，假裝在打掃，但他們也不趕我走。

scripts.text:

Do you wish to order? The dishes cost 3000 Zeny each - The weekend special is 5000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:

要點餐嗎？普通菜品每份3000 Zeny，週末特餐5000 Zeny。

好吃吧？

來，快來！
問，這裡哪裡？穆拉咖啡館，天天開。
石榴，賣這個，也賣那個。

scripts.translation: 你為什麼這樣說話？

scripts.text: Anything else?
scripts.translation: 還有其他嗎？

scripts.text:
[Pomegranate]
Have! Sap of Mora Village!
Sell! Beef toast.
Delicious. Beef toast. Much. Good~
Pomegranate!
scripts.translation:

有！穆拉村的汁！
賣！牛肉吐司！
好吃，牛肉吐司，好得很~
石榴！

scripts.text:
[Pomegranate]
Know you not, Mora Tongue.
Pomegranate. Know. Human speech.
Pomegranate, awesome.
Study, did. Super hard!
scripts.translation:
[石榴]
你不懂，穆拉話。
石榴，會，人類話。
石榴，厲害！
努力學，很努力！

scripts.text:
[Pomegranate]
Sell. Master. Fri-Sat-Sun.
Delicious. Squeezed fruit. Mora best!
scripts.translation:
[石榴]
師父，週五週六週日，賣！
鮮榨果汁，好喝，穆拉第一！

歡迎光臨穆拉咖啡館。
我們提供來自穆拉的水果和飲料。
它們是^4d4dff拉菲奇諾、穆拉高山茶、穆拉柑橘和穆拉漿果^000000。可能會缺貨。

如果沒有了，說明賣完了。明天再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Cocktail Master]
We are thankful that you came to visit us.
scripts.translation:
[調酒大師]
感謝您光臨本店。

scripts.text:
[Cocktail Master]
Do you wish to purchase special Mora Drinks?
We are saddened to inform you that we only make drinks on weekends. Come back on ^4d4dffFri, Sat, Sun^000000.
Pomegranate, sell this and that.
scripts.translation:
[調酒大師]
您想購買穆拉特調飲品嗎？
很遺憾，我們只在週末製作飲品。請在^4d4dff週五、週六、週日^000000再來。
石榴，把那些東西賣掉吧。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
We sell metal ores mined by our coalition.
If you need iron, steel, coal, or iron ores, look around.
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
我們出售由聯盟開採的金屬礦石。
如果您需要鐵、鋼、煤或鐵礦石，請四處看看。

scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Hans]
We are sold out, if there is nothing here.
We mine iron, steel, coal, and iron ores every day, so come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
如果沒有貨，說明已經賣完了。
我們每天開採鐵、鋼、煤和鐵礦石，請明天再來。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Our stock of basic metal like iron, steel, coal, etc, are replenished every day.
Keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
像鐵、鋼、煤等基礎金屬的庫存每天都會補充。
請記在心裡。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
We're closed today.
I am just about to visit the mines.
Come back tomorrow if you need anything.
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
今天休息。
我正準備去礦山。
如果您需要任何東西，請明天再來。

scripts.text:
[Dus the Smith]
Oridecon, Elunium, and Anvils here.
Not a lot, but handcrafted, you'll see.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 杜斯]
這裡有神之金屬、鋁和鐵砧。
數量不多，但都是手工製作的，您會看到的。

Not sure if we have any left.
Please buy if we do.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 杜斯]
不確定是否還有庫存。
如果有，請購買。

scripts.text:
[Dus the Smith]
Rare ores are hard to come by, and hard to refine.
That's why our stock is limited.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 杜斯]
稀有礦石很難獲取，也很難提煉。
這就是為什麼我們的庫存有限。

scripts.text:
[Dus the Smith]
Ah, a customer?
Sorry, we are not selling ores today.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 杜斯]
啊，有顧客？
抱歉，我們今天不賣礦石。

scripts.text:
[Dus the Smith]
They're hard to make, you see.
What do we sell you ask?
Ahhh, we sell Oridecon, Elunium, and Anvils here.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 杜斯]
它們很難製作，您知道的。
您問我們賣什麼？
啊，我們在這裡賣神之金屬、鋁和鐵砧。

scripts.text:
[Dus the Smith]
If you need rare ores or anvils, come on weekends.
Late Saturday afternoon would be perfect.
scripts.translation:
[鐵匠 杜斯]
如果您需要稀有礦石或鐵砧，請在週末來。
週六下午晚些時候最合適。

? Rain of Gems ?

[Days of Operation]

scripts.translation:
? 寶石雨 ?
我們經營黃金和寶石原石！

[營業日]
節假日休息。

Welcome~

scripts.translation:
[獵人 米斯特]
如果你需要獵鷹笛，我會以12,500 Zeny的價格出售。或者你覺得太貴了？

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
For Rangers, however, I have a special price of 10,000 zeny!
scripts.translation:
[獵人 米斯特]
不過，對於遊俠，我有10,000 Zeny的特價！

scripts.text: Don't buy one.
scripts.translation: 不買

scripts.text: Buy a Falcon Flute.
scripts.translation: 購買獵鷹笛

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
That's too bad. If you need one, come back!
scripts.translation:
[獵人 米斯特]
真遺憾。如果你需要，歡迎再來！

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
As I can see you already have a Falcon Flute!
Don't worry, my young friend, once you've purchased the Falcon Flute you won't need to do so again
since the Falcon Flute won't disappear upon usage, isn't that great?
scripts.translation:
[獵人 米斯特]
看來你已經有獵鷹笛了！
放心吧，年輕的朋友，買一支就夠了，因為獵鷹笛使用後不會消失。
很棒吧？

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
Here, take this flute.
With it you can whistle for your Falcon from anywhere.
scripts.translation:
[獵人 米斯特]
拿著，這是笛子。
有了它，你可以從任何地方吹哨召喚你的獵鷹。

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
Just a reminder.
You need the Skill ^ff0000Falcon Mastery^000000 in order to use it!
scripts.translation:
[獵人 米斯特]
提醒你一下，學會^ff0000馴鷹術^000000才能使用它！

scripts.text:
[Mist, the Hunter]
I'm sorry but you don't have enough money to buy a Falcon Flute, please come back when you have more money!
scripts.translation:
[獵人 米斯特]
很抱歉，你的錢不夠買獵鷹笛，請攢夠錢再來！

scripts.text:
[Mist the Hunter]
Look at other items in our store.
We may be offering a new Pet Items soon~
Hahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[獵人 米斯特]
看看我們店裡的其他商品吧。
我們很快可能會推出新的寵物道具~
哈哈哈！
